Yes, that's handled kindly. When the page couldn't be read, it told me plainly — "We couldn't read this page" and "this page didn't share its details, you can still name and save it yourself" — so I understood what happened and that it wasn't my fault or a dead end. The title and description boxes were empty and waiting for me to fill in, the site's name was still shown so I had something to go on, and there was a plain "no preview" placeholder instead of a broken picture. And I could still save the address.

That fallback feels sufficient to me. The whole reason I'm saving it is so I don't lose the link — so as long as it never just refuses and throws the address away, and lets me put in my own words, I'm happy. This does exactly that.
